Harrison Street, Pasay City Dear Mayor Calixto: This is in response to your letter 17 October 2013 seeking a legal opinion on the propriety and validity of certain appropriations for the Office of the Vice Mayor and the Sangguniang Panlungsod. In . letter, you viewed these items of appropriations as belonging to the local chief exer- and hence, they are duplication of projects. Further, you alleged that the estimated {r G.' ;ets for these items are too general and vague which may eventually affect the ;mplementation of the claimed projects. Plea: e be informed that to pass upon the legality or propriety of any item of expenditure in any local government unit's programmed appropriation is clearly not within the Department's mandate. The subject of your request pertains to matters that are cognizable by another agency, particularly in this case, the of Budget and Managemeut (DBM), an agency which has the authority, proficiency, and/or jurisdiction to appropriately address the issues. The DBM is mandated to review ordinances authorizing the annual or supplemel appropriations of provinces, highly-urbanized cities, independent component cities, and municipalities within the Metropolitan Manila Area.l With more reason thT said agency can render its opinion at this stage of the LGU's budget process, I • a, this Department's indorsement of your query. H remind tx er, by way of guidance and in the exercise of general supervision, may we Mayor that the Local Finance Committee (LFC) can also assist you in the disposition the subject matter. The LFC is mandated under Section 316 of RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 ('Code') to perform, among others, the following-' . Section 326, RA 7160 of the Local Government Code of 1991
